description: This file defines the SNProtocolOperator002 class, a legacy encryption protocol operator for handling key generation, encryption, decryption, and payload processing within a specific version (V002) of the encryption protocol. It extends SNProtocolOperator001 and includes methods for creating root keys, encrypting/decrypting data, and managing encrypted parameters.

classes.name: SNProtocolOperator002
classes.description: A legacy encryption protocol operator for version 002, handling key creation, encryption, decryption, and payload management, extending SNProtocolOperator001.

methods.name: generateNewItemsKeyContent
methods.description: Generates a new items key content with random keys for encryption and authentication, specific to protocol version 002.

methods.name: createItemsKey
methods.description: Creates a new items key payload for item encryption, returning a decrypted item.

methods.name: createRootKey
methods.description: Generates a new root key asynchronously based on identifier, password, and origination, using version 002 parameters.

methods.name: computeRootKey
methods.description: Computes the root key asynchronously, supporting dynamic iteration counts as per server-provided key parameters.

methods.name: decryptString002
methods.description: Decrypts a string using AES-256-CBC with provided key and IV.

methods.name: encryptString002
methods.description: Encrypts a string using AES-256-CBC with provided key and IV.

methods.name: encryptTextParams
methods.description: Encrypts text with a given encryption key and authentication key, generating a ciphertext with embedded parameters.

methods.name: decryptTextParams
methods.description: Decrypts text encrypted with encryptTextParams, verifying HMAC and returning plaintext.

methods.name: getPayloadAuthenticatedData
methods.description: Extracts authenticated data from an encrypted payload, decoding key parameters.

methods.name: generateEncryptedParametersAsync
methods.description: Generates encrypted parameters for a payload and key, splitting a generated item key into encryption and authentication parts.

methods.name: generateDecryptedParametersAsync
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted parameters asynchronously, reconstructing the original payload content.

methods.name: deriveKey
methods.description: Derives a root key asynchronously using PBKDF2 with parameters from SNRootKeyParams.

methods.name: encryptionComponentsFromString002
methods.description: Parses an encrypted string into its components for decryption, including version, hash, UUID, IV, ciphertext, and key parameters.
